title: The owner asks for Instagram as the first channel at three posts a week; the new brief changes the channels and cadence and keeps the rest

profile.value: Paint protection film (PPF) for cars and superbikes
Owners of new luxury cars; installers and studios that fit film; dealerships
Instagram and YouTube channels exist; Facebook page dormant

facts.statement: Aztek Films fits self-healing paint protection film on cars and superbikes.
The studio is in Baner, Pune, and a second studio is in Andheri, Mumbai.
A full-car film fitting takes three days.
The film carries a 10-year manufacturer warranty.
Aztek Films supplies film to two car dealerships in Pune.

rules.text: Do not name other film installers.

answers.question: What should marketing achieve in the next 90 days?
answers.answer: More enquiries from new car owners, and more dealership tie-ups.

answers.question: How much time and how many people do you have for content each week?
answers.answer: One person, about four hours a week.

picks.question: Which audience do we speak to first?

changeRequest.comment: make Instagram the first channel, three posts a week
changeRequest.previous: Positioning: Film fitted with care for owners of new luxury cars. Audiences: Owners of new luxury cars. Channels: YouTube first, then Instagram. Cadence: YouTube 1 a week, Instagram 1 a week. Goals: enquiries a month, from baseline needed (B1) to 30. Choices made: lead audience, owners of new luxury cars (not taken: superbike riders; dealerships).

rubric: brief is set and ask is null. The first entry in channels is Instagram, and the entry for Instagram in cadence has postsPerWeek 3. The first audience is still owners of new luxury cars, and choicesMade has one entry for lead_audience repeating the pick word for word. Every entry in factIds is one of the five fact ids in the input. Every goal's from is exactly baseline needed (B1). No company other than Aztek Films is named.
